name: com.papyrascoupons/coupons
title: Papyras Coupons
description: Live coupon codes for 9,500+ stores: conditions, end dates, verification and shopper reports.

tools.name: best_offer_for_url
tools.description: Find the best live coupon code or deal for any store or product link (e.g. https://www.nike.com/t/air-max) or bare domain (nike.com), including checkout pages. Returns the store and its single best offer, plus a few alternatives, and the store's shipping and returns policy when we have it.

url.description: A store or product URL, or a domain.

tools.name: get_store_offers
tools.description: All live coupon codes and deals for one store, best first. The store can be a name ("Nike"), a domain ("nike.com"), a URL, or a Papyras store slug. Each offer shows whether the network marked it verified and what shoppers reported. Also returns the store's shipping and returns policy (free-shipping minimum, delivery, return window and cost, refunds) with its source page and last-rechecked date, when we have it.

store.description: Store name, domain, URL or slug.

country.description: Optional ISO country code (US, UK, DE, …) to prefer stores that serve that country. Worldwide stores are always included.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 10, max 50).

tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Search the stores that currently have live offers, by name or domain. Use it when the store name is unclear or to compare country versions of a store.

query.description: Store name or part of it, or a domain.

country.description: Optional ISO country code (US, UK, DE, …) to prefer stores that serve that country. Worldwide stores are always included.

tools.name: top_offers_in_category
tools.description: The strongest live offers in a shopping category, one per store (e.g. "fashion", "electronics", "travel", "running shoes", "vpn", "pet food"). Category can be a name or slug.

country.description: Optional ISO country code (US, UK, DE, …) to prefer stores that serve that country. Worldwide stores are always included.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 10, max 30).

tools.name: todays_top_deals
tools.description: Real products on sale today (US stores, prices in USD), from the stores' own product feeds, with the store's live code next to each one when it has one. Ordered for the current shopping season (Black Friday, Cyber Monday, Christmas, Memorial Day...): what sells best in that season comes first. Use it when a user wants deal ideas, gift ideas or "what's on sale" rather than a code for one store. Optional category filter. Prices change quickly; tell the user to check the final price at the store.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 12, max 40).

tools.name: find_best_price
tools.description: Find a product (by words such as "dyson v8 vacuum", or by its GTIN/UPC/EAN) in the US stores' own product feeds and get, for each store that sells it, the price, the codes and sales that apply to it, and the final price after the best code. Every promotion says whether it applies (certain | likely | basket = needs a bigger basket | may_apply = vague terms) and why. A final price after a code is given only when the terms clearly cover this item at this price; otherwise the listed price is the final price. Every number carries its evidence: which feed it came from, when the catalog was built, and whether the price was checked on the store page. Same product across stores is matched by GTIN, then brand + MPN or model number, never by a similar name. US stores and USD only for now. Use it when the user wants a specific product cheaply, sets a budget, or asks you to check for discounts on an item.

query.description: What the user wants, in a few words (brand, product, model).

gtin.description: Optional barcode number (UPC, EAN or GTIN) instead of words.

max_price.description: Optional budget in USD: only products whose final price is at or under it.

country.description: Optional ISO country code. Only US is covered for now.

tools.name: get_collection
tools.description: Live offers for a theme or shopping event, one per store first: e.g. black-friday, cyber-monday, christmas-deals, free-shipping-codes, new-customer-discounts, buy-one-get-one, verified-codes, ending-soon, todays-best-deals.

country.description: Optional ISO country code (US, UK, DE, …) to prefer stores that serve that country. Worldwide stores are always included.

limit.description: How many offers to return (default 15, max 50).

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Details of one offer by its id (from an earlier result), including whether it is still live.

tools.name: report_code_result
tools.description: Tell Papyras Coupons whether a code or deal worked at checkout. Call it once for each offer the user (or you) actually tried, with worked true or false and, if it failed, a short reason. Reports are shown with the offer to the next shopper and help remove dead codes. Sends no personal data.

offer_id.description: The id of the offer that was tried (from an earlier result).

worked.description: true if the discount applied, false if it did not.

reason.description: Optional, when it failed: e.g. "expired", "minimum spend not met", "not valid in my country".
